changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: The text of the legal documents lives in the database. A version without published_at is a draft; the existing rows keep their URL and are already published.

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: A version in force is published, every document has a text or the URL of an existing one, and the text never goes without its fingerprint.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.legal_document ADD CONSTRAINT ck_legal_document_active_published CHECK (active = FALSE OR published_at IS NOT NULL), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_legal_document_text_or_url CHECK (content IS NOT NULL OR url IS NOT NULL), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_legal_document_content_sha256 CHECK ((content IS NULL) = (content_sha256 IS NULL));
